verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a SaaS compliance platform, so official SDKs are a fair question for it. The evidence only documents REST APIs (Alerts, Case, case listing, import, filing) and API key management. Raw APIs are adjacent building blocks, not official SDKs, and no client library in any language is mentioned. The OpenAPI probes also returned 404, so there is no published spec from which SDKs could be generated.
